column1: # note: Form D-400 line 15 reads "Multiply Line 14 by 4.25% (0.0425)". North Carolina prints no tax table or rate schedule; the flat rate is a one-row schedule for each of the five filing statuses the form offers.
# note: The form asks for whole dollars; the instructions (page 4) say to round 50 cents or more up.
